question: Which of the following is related to a purificatory ceremony called shuddhi for those Hindus who had been converted to other religions like Islam and Christianity?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Arya Samaj**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Arya Samaj, founded by Swami Dayanand Saraswati in 1875, is associated with the Shuddhi movement.
 
• Shuddhi ceremony aimed to reconvert those Hindus who had converted to other religions back to Hinduism.
 
• It was a significant part of Arya Samaj's efforts to purify Hindu society and restore Vedic principles.
 
• The movement was particularly focused on those who had been converted to Islam and Christianity, offering a way back to their ancestral faith.

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
 

 Option
 Details
 
 

 Veda Samaj
 Founded in Madras in 1864, focusing on the reinterpretation of Hindu scriptures and reform based on reason and monotheism.
 
 

 Ramakrishna Mission
 Established by Swami Vivekananda in 1897, it promotes social welfare, tolerance, and the teachings of its namesake saint, Ramakrishna Paramahamsa.
 
 

 Brahmo Samaj
 Launched by Raja Ram Mohan Roy in 1828, it aimed at reforming Indian society by advocating monotheism and denouncing caste discrimination and rituals.
